fixture_metadata.annotated_by: claude session 43; andrew spot-checked anchor fields session 44
fixture_metadata.spot_check_status: MEDIUM confidence per Andrew session-44 spot-check; corrections applied: insurer_name split into verbatim/canonical, actuarial_value_source flag added, in_coinsurance_default_post_deductible_only flag added, network_name corrected (Full PPO → Blue Shield of California PPO), appeals_contact populated with mailing address (was sparse; missed page entirely), NEW appeals_contacts array added with all 4 grievance categories from page 6 grievance table (medical/Rx, MHSA participating, MHSA non-participating, pediatric dental). Schema gaps documented for Phase 2 §10: cost_cap_per_unit (specialty Rx capped at $250/$500), multi-tier networks (MHSA Participating vs Non-Participating beyond simple in/out), coverage_conditions verbatim qualifiers for Other Covered services (with limitations etc).
notes: Annotation depth: FULL — all services + excluded + Other Covered + plan-level + appeals_contact. This is the worst-case bundled-PDF stress test for the parser (370 pages vs 7-12 pages for clean SBCs). The parser must locate the SBC within the bundle. Page 9 begins the bundled Evidence of Coverage (EOC); pages 10-370 contain the EOC + likely a child dental SBC + appendices.

Parser gap (not fixed in this PR): Insurer regex array in sbc-parser.ts has /blue\s*cross/ but NO /blue\s*shield/. Parser would emit insurer_name: null. Ground truth annotated as 'Blue Shield of California'. Adding /blue\s*shield/ pattern AFTER /blue\s*cross/ would resolve this without affecting Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield matches.
Marketplace type: SHOP (Covered California Small Business). Same regulatory regime as Blue Shield Bronze 60 PPO fixture.
MVS = 'Yes' (employer-style plan subject to ACA employer-mandate Minimum Value Standard).
Coverage tier: 'Individual + Family' — parser regex maps to 'individual_family'.
Coverage period uses 'Beginning On or After 1/1/2025' single-date format — relies on parser fix #2 from this PR.
Plan name: 'Blue Shield Silver 70 PPO 2500/55 PCP + Child Dental'. The '2500/55' encodes deductible/copay; 'PCP' indicates copay-based PCP visits; 'Child Dental' indicates pediatric dental embedded.

Subject to multiple per-day OON benefit maximums: $350/day for outpatient hospital (imaging, surgery, partial hospitalization, rehab, habilitation), $2,000/day for inpatient hospital + residential care.
Separate Rx deductible: $300 individual / $600 family (lower than Bronze 60 PPO's $450/$900). Tier 1 Rx exempt from deductible.
Adult routine eye care is EXCLUDED on this plan (matches Bronze 60 PPO; differs from Ambetter where it was 'Other Covered'). Captured as covered: false service entry AND in excluded_services_list.

'Services related to Abortion' is the SBC's exact 'Other Covered' wording — does NOT include 'covered in full' qualifier (unlike Ambetter). Per accuracy-above-all-else, cost fields are null (SBC didn't state). California state law SB 245 / AB 2134 may apply to SHOP plans; verify against EOC.

Mental health outpatient row breaks down into FOUR sub-categories: Office Visit, Other Outpatient Services, Partial Hospitalization, Psychological Testing — each at $55/visit with deductible waiver. Captured in cost descriptions verbatim.
Mental health inpatient row breaks down into THREE sub-categories: Physician Inpatient Services, Hospital Services, Residential Care — each at 35% coinsurance.

SUD parity: SBC section header explicitly mentions 'mental health, behavioral health, or substance abuse services' — parser SUD derivation will fire and emit substance_abuse_* entries mirroring mental_health_*. Annotated explicitly here matching the parser output.
excluded_services_list: non-emergency care when traveling outside the U.S.
